title: Pero Pero★Sparkles Anime's Promo Video Reveals January 10 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime of Yurie Sekiya 's Pero Pero★Sparkles characters began streaming on Wednesday a promotional video, and it reveals that the anime will premiere on January 10 at 7:00 a.m.
author: ANN

title: Sakamoto Days Season 2 Confirms Release Date Ahead of Shonen Jump Finale – Watch Trailer
content: Sakamoto Days might be gearing up to release the final chapter of its manga with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump this weekend , but the anime has now set a release date for its Season 2 return with a new trailer showing off the action.
author: ComicBook

title: KUKU-LOOP: The 100th Time's the Charm Anime Announced for 2027, Reveals Main Cast and Teaser Visual
content: KUKU-LOOP: The 100th Time’s the Charm TV anime adaptation was officially announced for 2027, revealing a teaser visual, main cast, and staff. The story follows Alphina, a duke’s daughter who has repeated the same life 99 times.
author: Anime Corner

title: KuKu-Loop: The 100th Time's the Charm Anime Reveals Main Cast, Staff, 2027 TV Debut
content: Pony Canyon revealed the teaser visual, main cast and staff, and 2027 premiere for KUKU-LOOP: The 100th Time's the Charm , the anime of storywriter Yūji Yūji and illustrator Nami Hidaka 's The 100th Time's the Charm: She Was Executed 99 Times, So How Did She Unlock “Super Love” Mode?! light novel series, on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Spice and Wolf Season 2 Announces January 2027 Premiere
content: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF Season 2 announced that the sequel is set to premiere in January 2027. Studio Passione is animating the remake, which also included an arc that wasn’t in the original anime. The first season concluded in September 2024 and the sequel was announced immediately.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Votoms Anime Films Stream 1st 9 Minutes
content: The staff for Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch), the two new anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise , started streaming the first film's first nine minutes on Wednesday.

content: The staff for the Oha Suta children's variety show announced on Tuesday the episode titles, main cast and staff members, and the November 24 premiere for the Oha Suta Daigo Gakuen (Good Morning Studio: V Academy) anime .
